hook.name: HoodpadV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all Hoodpad v2 graduated meme pools. Charges a protocol fee and per-pool creator tax on every swap via afterSwap return delta, accumulates them as pending balances, and allows a trusted sweep operator to convert memecoin-denominated fees to the quote currency via internal swaps and distribute proceeds to the protocol, creator, and a five-year buyback-and-lock vault.
